info.title: Deskbell widget API
info.description: The public API of a Deskbell instance: what the widget and the SDK call. It reads no cookies. Every route accepts OPTIONS for preflight; POST routes require an Origin header on the project's allowlist. Generated from the schemas the server validates with.

tags.name: Ask
tags.description: The one call that spends model tokens.

post.description: Streams the answer as server-sent events: `token` events, then `citations` or a `refusal`, then `done` with the ids feedback refers to. Lines beginning with a colon are heartbeat comments. Runs every guard, plus the daily token budget and the per-address stream cap.

projectKey.description: The project's public key, as printed in the embed snippet. Public by design.

sessionId.description: An identifier the client generated and keeps (the widget stores it in localStorage). A conversation belongs to the session that created it.

conversationId.description: Continue this conversation. Omit to start a new one. Must belong to the caller, or the response is 404.

message.description: The visitor's question, up to 4000 characters.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the visitor's UI language. Retrieval is cross-language.

context.description: Where on your site the conversation starts, as identifiers keyed by name. Stored on a new conversation only and ignored when continuing one.

approval.description: The visitor's answer to a `confirm` event: the call id and whether to go ahead. Continues the turn that paused in `conversationId`; `message` may be empty. A call that is not pending there, or has expired, is 404.

200.description: An event stream. Each `data:` line is one JSON event.

text.description: What to show instead of the refusal copy: the project's own reply to a `no_access` refusal, the question needing the visitor's data that nothing on the turn could read.

unsupportedTerms.description: Names the answer asserted that were found neither in the retrieved content nor anywhere in the corpus. Sent after `citations`, only when non-empty.

401.description: The project requires a visitor token and none was sent, or it failed verification. `reason` is `missing` or `invalid`.

403.description: The User-Agent looks like a crawler or an HTTP library, or the Origin is not on the project's allowlist.

404.description: Unknown project key, or a conversation the caller does not own.

429.description: A rate limit, the project's daily token budget, or the per-address stream cap. Retry-After says when.

retryAfter.description: Seconds until the caller may try again; also sent as Retry-After.

get.description: The project's widget appearance as saved on the Appearance page, plus `poweredBy`, which the server decides. Cached for 60 seconds.

post.description: Upserts the vote on one assistant message. A `down` vote is what notifications fire on and what the Gaps page counts.

projectKey.description: The project's public key, as printed in the embed snippet. Public by design.

sessionId.description: Must match the conversation's session: possession is the authorization.

messageId.description: The assistant message being rated, from the ask stream's `done` event.

feedback.description: The vote. `null` clears a previous one.

reason.description: A downvote reason id: one the project configured, or the built-in `incorrect`, `irrelevant` or `unaddressed`. Kept only with `down`.

comment.description: Free text with a downvote, up to 1000 characters. Kept only with `down`.

post.description: Sent once per tab session when the widget mounts. Records the request's Origin against the project so the Install page can show where the widget is live, including hosts not on the allowlist. Diagnostic only; grants nothing and skips the allowlist and identity checks.
